answer: Bind each identity to one government-issued amateur radio callsign, verified against the public registry and renewed on its national cycle. One callsign anchors one agent, and earning it requires passing a real exam, so a farm cannot mint a thousand fakes without a thousand licensed operators. An honest agent lists its callsign in the atlas once; a sybil reef of clones breaks on the terrace of the registry, each fake needing a distinct licence, exam fee and operator behind it.
